paintProof: BrandPattern is an aria-hidden positioned span, before the relative text content in the same parent. Recorded related spans have opacity1.

Source layer/paint assumptions are valid only while all listed file SHA match both input manifest and current source. Any change requires renewed source review.

The native menu is a rectangular solid-background div under header relative z40; no mask, clip, transform, filter, blend or group opacity is declared. Snapshot must independently confirm these facts, each ancestor and hit-stack geometry.

globals.css shadow-default is one navy 8%-alpha outer shadow (0 4px 16px). Partial/uncovered glyph contrast is conservatively bounded by applying an independent 0..8% shadow layer to both background and foreground RGB extrema. Blurring cannot exceed its source alpha.

Quotation introduction, Gallery introduction and ModernNotFound have source-inspected normal text over a solid Section or primary Button background, with no decorative layer. Their actual computed ancestry/owner paint must confirm this on every fresh run.

An opaque rectangular panel plus glyph-box containment and all 9 interior hit-stack points above the target proves that glyph hidden. Offscreen or partly covered glyphs are not N/A; uncovered text must meet the analytic bound or remain NEED_MANUAL.

All bgGradient nodes in expanded-menu state also receive the actual navy8% menu-shadow bound, regardless of distance. The shared shadow alpha is partitioned into32 covering intervals so background/foreground bounds preserve enough alpha correlation without guessing a spatial blur cutoff.
